title: Inside Rasa: Alan Nichol on Navigating the Future of Conversational AI
summary: Bluejay is the QA platform for AI agents. Rigorously test your voice agents—before and after deployment. Simulate edge cases, catch regressions, ensure security, and benchmark performance. Stop vibe testing. Quality is engineered.
body_markdown:
We broke our usual format for this one — and for good reason.


Most of[Bluejay (YC X25)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/get-bluejay/) 's Skywatch conversations take place in the car, but when you get the chance to sit down with[Alan Nichol](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anichol/) — co-founder and CTO of[Rasa](https://www.linkedin.com/company/rasa/) , the open-source platform powering next-generation conversational AI assistants — you take it.


In this episode we cover:
✨ Rasa’s evolution — from early concept to industry-shaping platform
🧠 What it really takes to build reliable, real-world conversational AI
🔮 Why voice technology is on the edge of transforming entire industries


If you’re building agents, thinking about the future of AI, or just curious how top founders operate — this one’s worth your time. 🙌


Huge thanks to Alan for joining — and for showing us where the future of open-source AI is headed 💙🐦
